text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next up is core training, correct?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Increasing the load from yesterday will be no problem. I shall weather any storm.
choice_data_list: You're bursting with motivation today, huh.
You're bursting with motivation today, aren't you?

text_block_list.text: Full of motivation, Yamanin Zephyr looked somewhat pleased as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
A gentle east wind blew through yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
First run...
Against that whirlwind...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
That girl... is doing independent training?
I just hope she's not pushing herself too hard again...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
I'm still... far from reaching that gale...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Next time, even more...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Working hard, are you? But if you push yourself too hard, you might hurt your leg again... So keep it in moderation, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. My legs... are fine.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, then alright... Wait, oh?
Indeed, your muscle balance looks much better
than when I last examined you.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Your core was really steady in that run earlier too...
Did you do some kind of special training?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe it's anything special.
—Just continuous adherence to the basics.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer told me that if I do that,
no matter how fierce the winds blow,
I won't be scattered..."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Hehe, I see.
You've found yourself a wonderful Trainer.
That puts my mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I too am grateful to the auspicious breeze
that guided our encounter."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: May the wind of blessing continue to blow upon me—
Yamanin Zephyr looks straight into my eyes. I resolve to keep supporting her conditioning so she can withstand the gale of her own running.
